entities.summary: Merhotepre Ini was a minor king in Ancient Egypt, thought to be the successor of Merneferre Ay in the late Thirteenth Dynasty of Egypt. The Turin King List assigns him a brief reign of 2 Years, 3 or 4 Months and 9 days.
